📊 Why the 14.5% Gap Between Black Market & Official Rate?
The 14.5% gap exists primarily due to foreign currency shortage in official banking channels, forcing businesses to seek USD through parallel markets at premium rates.

  • High demand for USD from importers and businesses

  • Diaspora remittance preferences for better rates

  • IMF program requirements and reform timeline
